prompt: Create a realistic full-body editorial portrait of a young Black man with short black hair, smooth medium-brown skin, natural facial proportions, clean-shaven face, calm introspective expression, eyes looking downward standing alone at the edge of the ocean on a misty overcast beach. He is centered slightly left of frame, photographed from head to shoes, with both hands tucked casually into his trouser pockets and his posture relaxed, head bowed gently as if in quiet thought. Dress him in exactly 4 visible outfit/accessory elements: a muted slate-blue short-sleeve linen camp-collar button-up shirt worn untucked and partly open at the neck, loose off-white linen trousers, clean white loafers, and a subtle bracelet or watch at one wrist. The shoreline curves diagonally behind and beside him, with dark wet sand under his feet, shallow reflective water, white sea foam wrapping around the foreground, and soft grey-blue waves receding into a hazy horizon. Use a calm, minimalist, cinematic mood that communicates quiet strength rather than drama. Lighting should be soft natural daylight under a pale grey sky, with low contrast, gentle shadows, muted colors, and shallow-to-moderate depth of field; background waves slightly blurred while the subject remains crisp. Composition should be vertical 4:5, eye-level to slightly low perspective, plenty of negative space in the sky, no text, no logos, no other people, no props, no stylization, photorealistic fashion photography with accurate fabric texture and natural skin detail.

promptZh: 创作一张写实的全全身编辑类肖像，主角为 一位留着黑色短发、肤色为中等棕色且光滑、面部比例自然、面容清爽、神情平静内敛、双眼向下看的年轻黑人男性，他独自站在雾气弥漫的阴天海滩边。构图上，他位于画面偏左侧，从头到脚全身入镜，双手随意插在裤兜里，姿态放松，头部微微低垂，仿佛陷入沉思。请为他搭配 4 件清晰可见的服饰/配饰：一件哑光石板蓝短袖亚麻古巴领衬衫（下摆自然垂下，领口微敞）、宽松的米白色亚麻长裤、干净的白色乐福鞋，以及手腕上的一款精致手链或手表。海岸线在他身后及身侧呈对角线延伸，脚下是深色的湿沙，浅滩处有倒影，白色的海浪泡沫环绕在前景，灰蓝色的海浪退向朦胧的地平线。采用平静、极简、电影感的氛围，传达出一种静谧的力量而非戏剧性。光线应为阴天苍白天空下的柔和自然光，低对比度，阴影柔和，色彩沉稳，景深适中；背景海浪略微虚化，主体保持清晰。构图采用 4:5 竖版，平视至微仰视角，天空留白充足，无文字，无 Logo，无其他人物，无道具，无风格化处理，呈现具有真实织物纹理和自然皮肤细节的写实时尚摄影效果。
